basics.name: Ryan Dormanesh
basics.label: Associate Producer / Production Coordinator / QA Lead
basics.summary: Production and QA lead based in Bonney Lake, WA. Worldwide mobile launch and live ops, Xbox 360 launch-window certification, and technical design on Red Dead Redemption. Independent Unity work since 2021.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Independent game designer and Unity developer. Shipped NumMerge, Guess Quest, Turtle Racing, and other finished small games.
highlights: NumMerge — numbered-ball merge puzzle (Arcade and Puzzle modes, leaderboards).
Guess Quest — higher-or-lower card game built in a day.
Turtle Racing — Twitch chat–driven racing experiment.

work.name: ESTsoft — Perfect Swing Golf (Unreal)
work.summary: Worldwide mobile launch and live ops on an Unreal golf game.
highlights: Worldwide mobile launch, then live updates.
Stood up CS ticketing and trained representatives across time zones for 24/7 coverage.
12-language localization with translation teams and engineers.
ASO and featuring on the Apple App Store and Google Play.
Used Google Firebase to set feature priority.
Tightened QA through launch and live updates.

work.name: Jam City — Cookie Jam
work.summary: Levels and live events for millions of daily players.
highlights: Analytics-informed difficulty and economy.
Unity editor live-ops tools.
Level tuner / final review for weekly content.
Early levels and mechanic iteration for Cookie Jam Blast.

work.name: Zynga — Cafe World
work.summary: Led QA for content releases during a developer transition, for a game with millions of DAU.
highlights: Content-release QA while the developing team was in transition.
Quality leadership on drops that still had to ship at live scale.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego — Red Dead Redemption
work.summary: Primary designer on the in-house animation state-machine tool.
highlights: 600+ state machines for player, AI, missions, animals, and NPCs.
Worked with animation programming to extend the tool.
Mentored two QA testers into design.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego — Table Tennis
work.summary: QA Lead through a Microsoft Xbox 360 launch-window ship.
highlights: Xbox 360 TCR through certification.
Focus-group testing.
Test automation with programmers.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego — Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition
work.summary: Quality assurance on a multiplayer-heavy racing game.
highlights: Gameplay, rendering, UI, crashes, and multiplayer coverage.

projects.name: Tropical Treats (MobilityWare)
projects.summary: Additional credit: level design and difficulty warnings. Not a dated staff role.
highlights: Level design.
Difficulty warnings on harder levels.
